'''Vader's Special Force Troopers''', also known simply as '''Special Force Troopers''', were specialized [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] that were visually identical to regular cold assault [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The Special Force Troopers, alongside a similar unit known as [[Darth Vader's Security Force]], were deployed during the [[occupation of Bespin]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SuperEMP" />
